 ORDER 1.The petitioner is the accused in S.T.No.3814 of 2015 on the file of the Judicial Magistrate of 1st Class, Kakkanad.
Offence alleged against him is under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and the rules framed thereunder.
2.On the failure of the petitioner to appear before the court below, Non Bailable Warrant has been issued.

sentences.text: 3.In this petition filed under Section 482 of the Code, it is prayed that directions be issued to the court below to consider his application for bail on the date of surrender itself.
The learned counsel submits that an application for compounding of the offence has been filed before the court below and the same is pending.

4.Having heard the learned counsel and the learned public prosecutor, this petition is disposed of by ordering that if the petitioner surrenders before the court below and moves appropriate application within a period of 2 weeks from today, with advance notice to the concerned prosecutor, the court below shall consider and dispose of the same, preferably on the date of surrender itself.
Coercive proceedings, if any, shall be kept in abeyance till then.

Sd/-
RAJA VIJAYARAGHAVAN.V., JUDGE kp/-26.10.16 T.M. Shamsudeen vs State Of Kerala on 26 October, 2016 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146639593/
